description: Helper agent run by mindroom.knowledge_graph.clients.MindRoomLLMClient.generate_response on anthropic claude-sonnet-5-5.

assistant.role: Answer questions about the team handbook.

messages.content:
You extract entities from conversations.

Any extracted information should be returned in the same language as it was written in. Only output non-English text when the user has written full sentences or phrases in that non-English language. Otherwise, output English.

<CURRENT MESSAGE>
Alice booked the Berlin offsite.
</CURRENT MESSAGE>

Respond with a JSON object in the following format:

{"$defs": {"ExtractedEntity": {"properties": {"name": {"description": "Name of the extracted entity", "title": "Name", "type": "string"}, "entity_type_id": {"description": "ID of the classified entity type. Must be one of the provided entity_type_id integers.", "title": "Entity Type Id", "type": "integer"}, "episode_indices": {"description": "List of episode numbers (0-indexed) this entity was extracted from. When processing a single episode, this should be [0].", "items": {"type": "integer"}, "title": "Episode Indices", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["name", "entity_type_id"], "title": "ExtractedEntity", "type": "object"}}, "properties": {"extracted_entities": {"description": "List of extracted entities", "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/ExtractedEntity"}, "title": "Extracted Entities", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["extracted_entities"], "title": "ExtractedEntities", "type": "object"}

entity_type_id.description: ID of the classified entity type. Must be one of the provided entity_type_id integers.
entity_type_id.title: Entity Type Id

episode_indices.description: List of episode numbers (0-indexed) this entity was extracted from. When processing a single episode, this should be [0].
episode_indices.title: Episode Indices
